acceptanceCriteria.text: `architecture-check.mjs` assigns explicit, reviewed layers to `src/workflow/`'s subtrees, `src/semantics/`, `src/context-runtime/`, and the remainder of `src/manager/` (no unexplained shared-layer fallback for load-bearing modules).

`coverage-policy.json`'s `criticalModules` includes, at minimum, `subprocess.ts`, `manager/service.ts`, `semantics/enforcement/*`, `nawabari.ts`, `process-registry.ts`, and `claim-preflight.ts`, with the baseline date/revision updated.
A test fails when a deliberately-introduced forbidden dependency edge is added.
A test fails when a critical-module test is removed without an accompanying policy update.

issue.title: refactor: align architecture-layer taxonomy and coverage-policy critical list with current module boundaries
